intro.heading: Tell us about your visit
paragraphs: Good Measure is independently assessing {venue}. This takes about four minutes.
It’s anonymous: we don’t ask your name, and the venue doesn’t see individual answers. You can skip any question.

outro.heading: Thank you.
paragraphs: Your answers have gone to Good Measure.
Something you’d rather tell us privately? Contact {privateContact}. We handle it separately from this survey.

questions.text: What did you come for today?
Is this your first visit? If not, roughly how often do you come?
Did you get the social experience you wanted?

followUp.text: What helped or got in the way? (optional)

questions.text: Did you feel acknowledged and treated with care?
Did you feel safe, respected and able to take part?

alert.text: If you’d like to tell us about this privately, contact {privateContact}. We handle it separately from this survey.

questions.text: Did sound, light, seating, access or service pace make your visit difficult?
Could you choose how much to drink, including alcohol-free options, without pressure?
What would bring you back, or stop you returning?
If you met or reconnected with someone, was that welcome?
options: I didn’t meet or reconnect with anyone

questions.text: Are you here on your own or with others?
How likely are you to come back in the next three months?
On a scale of 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend {venue} to a friend?
Roughly how much did you spend per person today?
Was it good value for what you spent?
Were there any costs you didn’t expect, such as a deposit, service charge or minimum spend?
How long did it take you to get here?
Have you taken part in a regular activity here, such as a quiz, club, class or community night?
Have you got to know someone here whom you now see or talk to outside the venue?
Does this place help you feel part of the local community?

sections.intro: Only share what you’re comfortable with.
